['Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism', 'From activities', 'Join compound_records on activities.record_id = compound_records.record_id', 'Join molecule_dictionary on compound_records.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno', 'Join compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno', 'Join assays on activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id', 'Join target_dictionary on assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid', "Filter target_dictionary.tid = (select tid from target_dictionary where target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' and pref_name = 'Aurora kinase A' and tax_id = 9606)", "Filter activities.standard_type = 'IC50' and activities.standard_relation = '=' and activities.standard_value is not null and activities.standard_units = 'nM'", 'Filter activities.activity_comment is not null', 'Filter compound_structures.canonical_smiles is not null', 'Filter activities.doc_id in (select doc_id from docs where pubmed_id is not null or doi is not null)', 'Return', 'Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism', 'Limit 1000']
